tasks.title: Announcement #66
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
tasks.transcript: Attention, everyone. Due to the upcoming construction work near our building, our class will be relocated to room 210 starting next Monday. Please take note of the change and arrive on time.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the announcement?

options.A: To inform students about a room change
options.C: To remind students to be punctual
options.D: To introduce a new class topic

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：这则公告的主要目的是什么？ 定位原文：Due to the upcoming construction work near our building, our class will be relocated to room 210 starting next Monday. Please take note of the change... 选项分析： A. To inform students about a room change 通知学生更换教室。公告的核心内容是告知教室从某地点更换到210房间，所以A选项正确。 B. To discuss the construction work 讨论施工事宜。公告只提及施工是换教室的原因，并未讨论施工本身，所以B选项错误。 C. To remind students to be punctual 提醒学生准时。公告提到“按时到达”，但这是附带的提醒，并非主要目的，所以C选项错误。 D. To introduce a new class topic 介绍新的课堂主题。公告中未提及课程内容的变化，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What should students do according to the announcement?
questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：根据公告，学生应该做什么？ 定位原文：our class will be relocated to room 210... please take note of the change and arrive on time. 选项分析： A. Arrive at the new room 到达新教室。公告明确说明课程转移到210房间，并要求学生按时到达，即去新教室上课，所以A选项正确。 B. Submit their assignments 提交作业。公告中未提及作业，所以B选项错误。 C. Contact the administration 联系行政管理部门。公告中未要求学生联系管理部门，所以C选项错误。 D. Check their emails 查收电子邮件。公告中未提及邮件，所以D选项错误。
